scope: Pinned-source coverage assessment, not a Coq proof check, solver query or browser verification. The reviewed model does not provide the registration/update lifecycle needed to represent our concrete maintenance counterexample.
assessedObligation: C4: app-controlled context creation or cached-resource delivery must not trigger a separate browser-owned service-worker update request.
decision: Do not use unmodified WebSpec to discharge this obligation. Its cache transitions and server-CSP-integrity invariant are different properties. Modeling registration, staleness, controller inheritance and update-script fetches, with browser correspondence, would be additional work.
